No — customer lifetime value (CLV/LTV) is not a governed metric in the Knowledge Plane. I read the routing table in kp/index.md whole and there is no concept for it: the closest approved measures are kp:AverageOrderValue (sales.sales_performance.average_order_value), kp:OrderCount and kp:TotalSales, plus kp:ActiveCustomer as a defined class, but none of those is a lifetime-value definition and I will not compose one, because an ungoverned metric assembled on the fly would carry no agreed definition of horizon, margin basis, or discounting. If you want it, it needs to be modelled and approved first — worth raising in the gap log so a steward can define it. I ran no query, so there are no numbers to report.
